titre: Électricité consommée par les centres de données en Irlande

series.nom: Consommation électrique comptée des centres de données

2023.texte: Metered electricity consumption by data centres increased by 10% from 6,335 Gigawatt hours (GWh) in 2023 to 6,969 GWh in 2024.

2024.texte: rising from 6,973 Gigawatt hours (GWh) in 2024 to 7,663 GWh in 2025.

2025.texte: Metered electricity consumption by data centres increased by 10% in a single year, rising from 6,973 GWh in 2024 to 7,663 GWh in 2025.
